objective: Construct and smoke-test the six Step 5 internal arms plus four seeded semantic-transformation classes without running or scoring Gate A.

step5.interpretation: DRAFT_UNSEALED_DO_NOT_SCORE construction requirements only; Step 7 owns final cases, policies, hashes, controls, scoring, and seal.

baseline_construction.counting_limit: These are construction appearances, not deduplicated scored cases or independent families.
baseline_construction.policy_status: No human-authored/reviewed sigma is supplied in Step 6a; direct P/O/E and equal-policy scored readiness must remain unresolved.

transformations.transformation_argument: Capture-avoiding alpha-renaming changes source identifiers and ABI field names but not parameter types/order, loop bounds, equality constraints, positional consumer mapping, or XOR effect.
The exact prefix loop is moved into a single helper called once with unchanged value arguments; there are no side effects outside constraints and the public ABI is unchanged.
Field equality is symmetric, so expected[i] == values[i] and values[i] == expected[i] define the same constraint at every executed loop index.

transformations.class: matched public-input reordering with producer-consumer correspondence preserved
transformations.transformation_argument: Move active_count from physical word 4 to 0 and payload words from 0..3 to 1..4 on both producer ABI and consumer reads; logical types, values, prefix condition, and four-word XOR are preserved by the explicit bijection.

transformations.class: matched public-input reordering with producer-consumer correspondence preserved
transformations.reason: A Payy reorder would require rebuilding both recursive layers, artifact-specific mapping certificate, revision-specific key/verifier, proof, and consumer execution controls. Reusing pinned certificates or keys would be unsound, and that proof campaign is outside this construction smoke budget.

An application-level WarpToad helper refactor would change compiled artifacts and require a new correspondence, key/verifier, proof, and original-consumer execution chain. The authored D1P-42 control is used instead; no application equivalence is assumed.

resource_budget.memory_limit: No hard memory cap is asserted for this construction runner; this prevents a resource-enforcement claim.

stop_rules: Refuse to overwrite any D2-06A output namespace.
Stop on a Step 5, source, tool, or composition-module hash mismatch.
Preserve unsupported transformation analysis and preconstruction rejection reasons; do not replace them after output.
Do not run a scored comparison, proof generation, reserved input, network query, or live consumer action.
claim_limits: This is construction and smoke-test evidence only; no target was scored and no Gate A decision was made.
Authored transformations and focused controls do not prove general semantic equivalence.
Compilation and existing tests are not treated as sufficient equivalence evidence.
Candidate counts are not detections, misses, false warnings, precision, recall, transfer, or prevalence.
The absent human-reviewed sigma and unequal generic-policy consumption leave strong-simple versus full equal-policy scoring unresolved.
Step 7 must independently finalize and seal exact bytes before any scored execution.
